name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.89.0 — atlas cards clamp every mock preview to one fixed height (`.shot` max-height 520px, overridable via `--v-shot-max`); the clipped remainder fades out and the click-to-inspect lightbox still shows the full mock — a tall mock no longer makes a tall card (JJ 2026-09-06). 7.88.0 — the plugin ships its own dependency-free browser capture (`render-capture.js`, an installed Chrome driven over DevTools with Node built-ins, `spec-paths render-capture`): `render-gate --mocks` falls back to it when the host declares no `design.render.capture` (`--which` names the remedy — `CHROME_BIN`, install Google Chrome, or declare `design.render.capture` — before any capture runs) and, with no `design.rulesManifest`, runs the plugin's own `spec/templates/adaptation-rules.json` (no-overflow, desktop-fill, line-length) in place of the skip line; `--spec` mode is unchanged. The mocks driver runs this gate at every `journey-approved` and at `approved`, refusing the mark on a finding or on a machine with no browser — no rendered check had ever run on a mocks-first product before this. ADR-0007 amends ADR-0002, reversing specs/20260824/01 D1's "never launches a browser itself" for this fallback path only. 7.87.0 — `render-rules.js`'s closed `renderCheck.kind` set gains `desktop-fill` (`spec/templates/design-rules.json` ships the template row, `minFraction` 0.5 `minViewport` 1024): it measures the in-flow content span against `page.clientWidth` at cells at or above `minViewport` and fails a phone-width column centred on a desktop unless the mock's root declares `data-narrow` — Hearwell's client shell was the measured case, a 430px column at 26–28% of 1440px, ratifiable clean under every existing rule; `render-inventory.browser.js`'s inventory gains top-level `narrow` (the labeled root's `data-narrow`, `schemaVersion` stays 1); `spec/templates/mocks-canon.md` § Shells now asks each shell what it does at every declared viewport before the first screen is drawn.
